id: \bThis area used to be a meadow.
en: \bThis area used to be a meadow.

id: Royal Avenue\nThe holy ground for Battle Royal enthusiasts.
en: Royal Avenue\nThe holy ground for Battle Royal enthusiasts.
it: Viale Royale\nLa terra sacra per gli appassionati di Battle Royal.

id: \bThis isn't cutting the tree like I thought. You can take it.
en: \bThis isn't cutting the tree like I thought. You can take it.
it: \bNon taglia l'albero come pensavo. Puoi prenderlo tu.

id: \bI'll figure it out on my own.
en: \bI'll figure it out on my own.

en: \rI came to watch the Masked Royal. I can't get enough of him.
it: \rSono venuta a vedere il Reale Mascherato. Non mi stanco mai di lui.

id: Rotom Phone: Incoming call from Oak:
en: Rotom Phone: Incoming call from Oak:
it: Smart Rotom: Chiamata in arrivo da Oak:

id: \bOak: \PN, good to hear from you. I know how busy you are, but I'd like you to stop by the lab. There's something important waiting for you here.
en: \bOak: \PN, good to hear from you. I know how busy you are, but I'd like you to stop by the lab. There's something important waiting for you here.
it: \bOak: \PN, che piacere sentirti. So quanto sei impegnato, ma vorrei che passassi al laboratorio. C'è qualcosa di importante che ti aspetta qui.

id: \bI wish I could get strong enough to enter one of those battles.
en: \bI wish I could get strong enough to enter one of those battles.
it: \bVorrei diventare abbastanza forte da partecipare a una di quelle lotte.
